questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of all living organisms?
choices: They can move from one place to another
They can reproduce by laying eggs
They can grow and develop
They can live without water
questions.solution: All living organisms have the ability to grow and develop, which is a fundamental characteristic that distinguishes them from non-living things. Not all organisms can move, reproduce by laying eggs, or survive without water, making those options incorrect.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सभी जीवित जीवों की विशेषता है?
choices: वे एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर गति कर सकते हैं
वे अंडे द्वारा प्रजनन कर सकते हैं
वे बढ़ सकते हैं और विकसित हो सकते हैं
वे पानी के बिना जीवित रह सकते हैं
hi.solution: सभी जीवित जीवों के पास बढ़ने और विकसित होने की क्षमता होती है, जो उन्हें अजीवित वस्तुओं से अलग करने वाली एक मूलभूत विशेषता है। सभी जीव गति नहीं कर सकते, अंडे द्वारा प्रजनन नहीं कर सकते, और पानी के बिना जीवित नहीं रह सकते, जिस कारण इन विकल्पों को गलत माना जाता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology consistent with standard biology textbooks.

questions.stem: A plant produces its own food, while an animal depends on other organisms for food. What does this show?
choices: Plants can grow without sunlight
Animals are not living organisms
Plants and animals have different modes of nutrition
Plants and animals have the same mode of nutrition
questions.solution: The statement shows that plants and animals have different ways of obtaining their food, as plants make their own food using sunlight, while animals consume other organisms. This directly supports the idea that they have different modes of nutrition. The other options are incorrect because they either contradict the process of photosynthesis or incorrectly classify animals as non-living.

hi.stem: एक पौधा अपना भोजन स्वयं बनाता है, जबकि एक जंतु अन्य जीवों पर निर्भर रहता है। यह क्या दर्शाता है?
choices: पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश के बिना बढ़ सकते हैं
जंतु जीवित जीव हैं नहीं
पौधे और जंतु अपने पोषण के विभिन्न तरीके हैं
पौधे और जंतु एक ही प्रकार के पोषण के हैं
hi.solution: कथन दर्शाता है कि पौधे और जंतु अपने भोजन के अलग-अलग तरीके हैं, क्योंकि पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश के उपयोग से अपना भोजन बनाते हैं, जबकि जंतु अन्य जीवों को खाते हैं। यह सीधे विचार के समर्थन में है कि उनके पोषण के अलग-अलग तरीके हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे फोटोसिंथेसिस की प्रक्रिया के विरोध में हैं या गलती से जंतुओं को अजीव बताते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate biological terminology.

questions.stem: Why do hatchlings move towards the bright light after hatching?
choices: To find shelter
To find food
To reach the sea
To avoid predators
questions.solution: Hatchlings move towards the bright light because the sea reflects more light than the surrounding environment, guiding them to water, which is essential for their survival. Finding shelter, food, or avoiding predators is not the primary reason for their movement towards light, as their immediate need is to reach the water.

hi.stem: अंडे से बाहर आने के बाद हैचलिंग क्यों चमकदार प्रकाश की ओर जाते हैं?

भोजन खोजने के लिए

hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used.

questions.stem: A seed has stored food for the growing seedling. What happens to this stored food?
choices: It is used for the growth of the seedling
It is excreted out of the seed
It is used to attract animals
It is converted into energy for movement
questions.solution: The stored food in a seed is used to provide energy and nutrients for the seedling as it grows. The other options are incorrect because seeds do not excrete food, they do not use food to attract animals, and movement is not a primary function of stored food in seeds.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains why plants are considered living organisms?
choices: They can grow and develop
They can move from one place to another
They can reproduce by laying eggs
They can feel heat and cold
questions.solution: Plants are considered living organisms because they can grow and develop, which is a fundamental characteristic of life. The other options are incorrect because plants do not typically move from one place to another, they do not reproduce by laying eggs, and they do not have the ability to feel heat and cold like animals do.
